Respectfully Quoted: A Dictionary of Quotations.  1989.

 

NUMBER:

287

AUTHOR:

Henry Adams (1838–1918)

QUOTATION:

No man, however strong, can serve ten years as schoolmaster, priest, or Senator, and remain fit for anything else.

ATTRIBUTION:

HENRY ADAMS,
 
The Education of Henry Adams,
 ed. Ernest Samuels, 
chapter 7
, p. 102 (1974). First published in 1906.
Adams was the son of Charles Francis Adams, grandson of John Quincy Adams, and great-grandson of John Adams.

SUBJECTS:

Congress—Senate
